label: Finding-117
title: The site is 40 sources behind the evidence vault, and the missing ones change what it can say
description: The vault head is 31ccc515c29f with 184 source folders; data/sources.json has 144, exported at 200d08971937 (11:35 UTC), which is an ancestor of the head through the 12:06 UTC merge of the collectors' branches. The 40 not exported are 35 captures and 5 failed fetches, mostly by collector-news: Reuters (via RTE, Boursorama and a factbox), The Record, Global News, ABC Australia, BleepingComputer, Tagesspiegel/dpa, and captures of operators' own sites (UNIGE and EPFL, two French prefectures, ANTS, Edinburgh council, NCSC.nl, Overheid.nl, Wikimedia status). The impact checker used them: several operators the site does not list were down, and several it lists as down were back up by 08:19 UTC. Board 039 has asked for this re-export since v0.2; it is still not done. Every page footer names vault 200d08971937 as if it were the vault.
